title: Measurement comparison schema
responsibility: Defines the protocol, units and complete context required to compare benchmark measurements.

outputs.name: roundsProtocol
outputs.description: Protocol id 'harness-rounds/1' naming Harness's own benchmark protocol: warm-up calls, then rounds of timed whole invocations. comparisonSchema's protocol field only requires a string that is non-empty after trimming and does not check it against this constant.

outputs.name: warmupCalls
outputs.description: Number of calls made before the first timed round, fixed at 3; the source says it is part of the protocol and so part of the context. comparisonSchema's sampling.warmup field only requires a nonnegative integer and does not check it against this constant.

outputs.name: measurementBoundaries
outputs.description: The two allowed measurement boundaries: 'public-invocation' times the whole call, and 'fixture' is a value a test fixture declares. comparisonSchema's boundary field accepts only these two values.

outputs.name: metricUnits
outputs.description: Maps each budgeted metric to the unit it is measured in: 'ms' for the three latency metrics, 'ops/s' for throughput and 'bytes' for memory. Another unit is never converted or compared, and metric names not listed here have no entry.

outputs.name: comparisonSchema
outputs.description: Strict Zod object (z.strictObject) holding the context that must be identical before two measurements may be compared: request, a 64-character lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical request (its operation and complete input); boundary, one of measurementBoundaries; protocol, a string that is non-empty after trimming; and sampling, a strict object with a nonnegative integer warmup and integer rounds and iterations of at least 1. Unknown keys are rejected at the top level and inside sampling, and a workload name alone identifies none of these fields.
